claims.content: To allow vehicles to enter the reversible lane facility from the adjacent main lanes by safely opening the entrance closure devices in a specified sequence, enabling traffic flow in the designated direction for peak hours or special events as directed by the operator.

goal.raw_text: To allow vehicles to enter the reversible lane facility from the adjacent main lanes by safely opening the entrance closure devices in a specified sequence, enabling traffic flow in the designated direction for peak hours or special events as directed by the operator.

claims.content: Operator
The operator must be logged on to the control unit console before issuing commands.
The status of all entrance closure devices in the system must be known and displayed to the operator.
No entrance closure device for the opposite direction of travel may be in an 'open' or 'unknown' status.
The operator must perform a status check of all devices before initiating the opening sequence.
The operator initiates the opening sequence to accommodate morning or evening peak traffic hours or special events.

trigger.raw_text: The operator initiates the opening sequence to accommodate morning or evening peak traffic hours or special events.

claims.content: The operator performs a status check of all devices before initiating the opening sequence.
The operator closes the gate at the south end (Gate 1 or Gate 5 depending on direction) to prevent entry from the opposite direction.
The operator opens the Wrong Way (WW) pop-ups or lights to mark the boundary of the reversible lane.
The operator opens the Draw Light or other signaling devices at the north end.
The operator opens the Entrance (EN) pop-ups to allow vehicles to enter the reversible lane.
The operator opens or updates the Changeable Message Signs (CMS) to indicate the lane is open.
At any point in an opening sequence, the sequence shall be halted if a device fails to report completion of the current sequence step within the response time window allotted for the step.
At any point in an opening sequence, the sequence shall be halted if the status of a closure device for the opposite direction of travel changes to 'unknown' or 'open'.
At any point in an opening sequence, the sequence shall be halted if the status of a closure device, which was previously opened at the current entrance, changes to 'unknown' or 'closed'.

A 'halted' opening sequence shall cause the system to enter a 'hold' state for a system specified time; if the offending device status can be corrected within that period, the operator may enter a 'resume' command to attempt completion of the original sequence.
At any point in an opening sequence, the sequence shall be halted if a device fails to report completion of the current sequence step within the response time window allotted for the step.
At any point in an opening sequence, the sequence shall be halted if the status of a closure device for the opposite direction of travel changes to 'unknown' or 'open'.
At any point in an opening sequence, the sequence shall be halted if the status of a closure device, which was previously opened at the current entrance, changes to 'unknown' or 'closed'.
A 'halted' opening sequence shall cause the system to enter a 'hold' state for a system specified time.

If the offending device status can be corrected within the specified time period, the operator shall be able to enter a 'resume' command in order for the system to attempt to complete the original opening sequence.
All entrance closure devices for the specified direction (Barrier Gate, Entrance Longitudinal/Transverse Pop-ups) are in the 'open' position.
Wrong Way Transverse and Longitudinal Pop-ups marking the boundary of the reversible lane are in the 'open' (deployed) position.
Changeable Message Signs (CMS) display the 'Open' message to traffic.
The status of all entrance closure devices for the opposite direction of travel remains 'closed'.
